description: BingX has secured authorisation from Austria’s Financial Market Authority through its European subsidiary, MEGE zweite GmbH, under the EU’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation. The approval covers four specific crypto services and is intended to support expansion across 29 European Economic Area markets. The exchange has not announced a launch date, and access to individual markets will depend on completing the required cross-border notification process.
title: BingX Secures Austrian Crypto Licence to Expand Across 29 EU Countries

description: Panasonic has announced festive offers on select air conditioners, microwave ovens and soundbars in India. The brand is providing up to Rs. 5,000 cashback and additional benefits on its products. The offers are valid till November 30, 2026. Customers can get up to 10 percent cashback, capped at Rs. 4,000, on eligible products listed under the Multi-Brand Outlet (MBO) catalogue. Buyers shopping through the Exclusive Brand Outlet (EBO) catalogue are eligible for up to 12.5 percent cashback, capped at Rs. 5,000, on select models.
title: Panasonic Announces Festive Offers on Air Conditioners, Microwave Ovens and Soundbars in India

description: Amazon’s Great Indian Festival offers interesting deals on wearables from big-name brands. These include the Apple Watch Series 11, Garmin Vivoactive 5, and even the Galaxy Watch 8. These premium watches are available at attractive discounts and offer a wide range of health and sports tracking features.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Premium Smartwatch Deals

description: Smartphones with higher storage capacities are becoming increasingly expensive amid rising memory prices. This makes it difficult for those to store a lot of media on their phone. A practical solution is to use an external storage device, providing a separate space for photos, videos, and other files. External solid-state drives (SSDs) are a compelling alternative to traditional hard disk drives (HDDs). They offer significantly faster data transfer speeds in compact, portable designs. While SSDs generally cost more than conventional HDDs, the Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 brings discounts of up to 70 percent on select models.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best SSD Deals from SanDisk, Samsung, Seagate and More

description: The European Banking Authority has classified Circle’s USDC as the first significant e-money token under the EU’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation. The designation follows an assessment of the stablecoin against MiCA criteria, including holder numbers, transaction activity, and token value. From November 12, supervision will be shared between the EBA and France’s banking regulator, the ACPR, with oversight covering key financial safeguards.
title: Circle’s USDC Leads as First Stablecoin Subject to Fall Under New EU Rules

description: Sony has announced the lineup of games joining PS Plus Game Catalogue in October. The titles include Mafia: The Old Country
title: PS Plus Game Catalogue Will Add Mafia: The Old Country, Mycopunk, The Midnight Walk and More in October

description: OnePlus Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro have popped up on the Google Play Supported Devices List. The standard OnePlus Ace 7 carries the model number PYF110 and device code OP68BBL1, while the Ace 7 Pro is listed with the model number PMS110 and device code OP64F1L1. The listing suggests that the launch is around the corner. OnePlus Ace 7 series is speculated to feature a 9,000mAh battery.
title: OnePlus Ace 7, Ace 7 Pro Listed on Google Supported Devices List Ahead of Launch

description: Logitech, on Thursday, announced that it has started manufacturing locally in India at its new Manesar plant in Haryana. This is the company’s manufacturing plant in the country. Logitech says that the operationalisation of its new facility aligns with the vision of the government’s Make in India initiative. The tech firm will initially manufacture “high-demand” workspace products, including webcams and pointing devices or mice, for PCs and laptops. Further, Logitech’s new manufacturing facility in Manesar expands on its existing presence in the country. The company already has a Global Capability Center in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, which provides operational support, including channel management and marketing support.
title: Logitech Starts Local Manufacturing in India, Products to Roll Out From Manesar Plant

description: The Brooklyn District Attorney’s Office and the FBI have dismantled infrastructure allegedly used by an Eastern European cryptocurrency investment scam network. The operation involved shutting down 241 websites and 112 servers across multiple jurisdictions. Prosecutors said the scheme targeted Russian-speaking Americans through fraudulent investment offers and later attempted to exploit victims again with fake cryptocurrency recovery services.
title: US Crypto Scam Crackdown Brings 241 Website Shutdowns by FBI, Brooklyn DA

description: Google has introduced a new ‘Shop devices’ option in the Google Play Store, allowing users to discover its hardware products directly from the app. The feature has quietly started appearing in select regions, including India. The new option is available in the Play Store’s account switcher. It provides a shortcut to the Google Store. In some regions, Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra models are listed under the Shop device menu.
title: Google Play Store ‘Shop Devices’ Feature Goes Live in India With Pixel Phones and Accessories

description: Oppo has reportedly started working on a new wide-folding phone, as its key specifications and features have surfaced online. The leaker claims that the foldable will be equipped with a 6.35-inch flat display on the outside with a 1,440 x 2,560 pixels resolution, which could be rated as either 1.5K or 2K. The handset might also boast an 8T LTPO panel and the same pixel density as a 1.5K resolution display. It might also offer a 16:9 aspect ratio. Apart from this, Oppo’s rumoured wide-folding smartphone might feature an ultrasonic fingerprint scanner for security, along with face unlock support.
title: Oppo Wide-Folding Phone Key Display Features Tipped Ahead of Launch: Expected Specifications

description: iQOO has confirmed that the Pad Pro 8.8 will launch in China soon. Ahead of the official launch, the company has revealed several key specifications of the upcoming tablet. It is expected to launch alongside the iQOO Neo 12 this month. The company started accepting pre-orders for the tablet through its official website, JD.com, Tmall and Douyin.
title: iQOO Pad Pro 8.8 Launch Teased; Confirmed to Feature 9,020mAh Battery

description: The Ministry of Communications' Department of Telecommunications (DoT) announced on Tuesday that all authorised TSPs have been “instructed” to roll out the CNAP service in their 4G and newer-generation telecommunication networks, including 5G, across all service areas from November 1. This means that the CNAP service will be enabled for the 6G telecommunication networks when it is released by TSPs. On the other hand, the introduction of the CNAP service for 2G and 3G networks, along with landline connections, will be considered separately. Further, the notification highlights that every new authorised TSP will also have to ensure the default implementation of the new caller identification service for their respective 4G, 5G, and newer generation telecommunication networks. DoT’s order states that CNAP should be rolled out after securing it from tampering.
title: DoT Mandates Caller Name Presentation for 5G and 4G Networks From Next Month

description: Apple launched the iPhone Duo as its first foldable in September, and it is easily the most expensive iPhone to date. In India, the handset starts at Rs. 2,99,900, almost touching the Rs. 3 lakh mark. While its pre-orders have yet to begin, repairing the iPhone Duo could prove just as expensive. Apple has revealed the repair cost of the foldable, and it suggests that even a single out-of-warranty repair could cost a significant portion of its original price.
title: iPhone Duo Screen Repair in India Costs Almost as Much as an iPhone 18 Pro

description: The iPhone Duo shares much of its hardware with the iPhone 18 Pro models, including the Cupertino-based tech giant’s latest flagship 2nm A20 Pro chipset. On the other hand, it introduces a different form factor, making its performance an important part of the overall experience. The Apple foldable is set to be made available for pre-order in India tomorrow, and it has now surfaced on a benchmarking site, revealing how it performs.
title: iPhone Duo Matches iPhone 18 Pro Models in Terms of Performance, Geekbench Listing Reveals

description: Tecno Spark 50S 5G will be launched in India on October 16 at 12 pm IST, the company announced on Wednesday. The handset will be the second phone in the Spark 50 series in India, joining the recently launched Tecno Spark 50 5G. The soon-to-be-launched Tecno Spark 50S 5G will go on sale in the country in two colour options, namely Burgundy Red and Breeze Blue. In terms of design, the phone is similar to the standard model. The Tecno Spark 50S 5G will sport a horizontally-aligned pill-shaped rear camera island. A single camera sensor will be placed on the back of the handset, along with a light sensor and an LED flash. It will also sport a flat rear panel, with the Tecno branding placed at the bottom. The handset is shown to feature a flat mid-frame with a metallic finish.
title: Tecno Spark 50S 5G India Launch Date Revealed Along With Design, Colour Options

description: As scammers move beyond phishing and standard calling techniques, Google is using AI models to detect scams and fraud by issuing warnings, alerts, and even blocking users from connecting with malicious entities. Google is rolling out new tools that will work with messages and calls.
title: Google AI to Add More Anti-Scam Protections to Messages and Calls on Android Devices

description: The standard iPhone 18 will reportedly begin production towards the end of November. The smartphone is tipped to debut in the first quarter of 2027, potentially alongside the iPhone 18e. Apple's inventory level reportedly shows that the company is preparing for substantial inventory of the upcoming device. Apple may be expecting strong initial sales when the handset becomes available. Both devices are expected to be powered by Apple's A20 chipset
title: iPhone 18 Reportedly Set to Enter Production Soon; Apple Anticipating Strong Demand

description: Redmi K100 is expected to be launched soon in China at a lower price than the recently launched Redmi K100 Pro series. The leaker claims that the smartphone will be priced in China at around CNY 3,500 (roughly Rs. 50,000). The leaker further says that the phone will be powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset, along with 12GB of LPDDR5x RAM and 256GB of UFS 4.1 onboard storage. This configuration is said to cost about CNY 3,000 (about Rs. 43,000). The additional CNY 500 (roughly Rs. 7,000) cost reportedly accounts for the extra features that the Redmi K100 is expected to offer. The smartphone is said to ship with an improved built-in active fan for thermal management.
title: Redmi K100 Launch Price Tipped Online Along With Key Specifications

description: Epic Games has released a new "vibe coded" Epic Games Store Launcher in preview on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Epic said "programming is hard", and so it used AI to code the new launcher. The company claims the launcher is faster than Steam. However, the new Epic Games Store launcher has faced backlash and users have reported major bugs.
title: Epic Games Releases New 'Vibe Coded' Epic Games Store Launcher in Preview, Faces Backlash Over Bugs

description: Samsung officially started rolling out the Android 17-based One UI 9 update to the Galaxy S26 series last month. Now, the company appears to have started rolling out the update to select Galaxy S23 and Galaxy Z Fold 5 users in South Korea. The software release is not widely available yet. The Galaxy S23 series One UI 9 update has version numbers S918NKSU8GZIF, S918NOKR8GZIF and S918NKSU8GZIF.
title: Samsung Galaxy S23 Series, Galaxy Z Fold 5 Start Receiving One UI 9 Update Based on Android 17: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ will reportedly not launch with an upgraded selfie camera. The report highlights that the Samsung Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ will be equipped with a 12-megapixel camera on the front for selfies and video calls, which could be the same as their predecessors. The company has equipped its Galaxy S series phones with the same 12-megapixel selfie shooter since the Samsung Galaxy S23 lineup, which was launched globally in February 2023. If this is true, it would be the fifth in a row that the South Korean tech giant will equip its Galaxy S series phones with the same camera sensor on the front. On the other hand, the report claims that the higher-end Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will be launched with a new 16-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ to Launch Next Year With the Same Selfie Camera as Galaxy S26: Report

description: Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) is one of the most popular online battle royale games in the country, with over 10 crore downloads currently. Krafton, the developer behind BGMI, is gearing up to introduce its lighter version to make it accessible to a wider range of devices. The upcoming title, initially announced as BGMI Lite, has now received a new name as anticipation builds ahead of its launch later this year. Krafton added that its pre-registration campaign has reached a major milestone, with an open beta planned ahead of the full launch.
title: Krafton Renames BGMI Lite to BGMI Air Ahead of Launch in India as Pre-Registrations Cross 10 Million

description: Bitcoin faces renewed pressure after US inflation accelerated to 3.7 percent in September, prompting traders to reassess the Federal Reserve’s rate outlook. Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $175.6 million in inflows, but rising Treasury yields and mixed global market sentiment continue to weigh on prices. Investors are watching Federal Reserve commentary for clues about the next policy move.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $81,000 as Hot US Inflation Revives Fed Rate Concerns

description: Oppo Reno 17 will be launched in India in January 2027, according to a report. Moreover, the purported hands-on image of the Oppo Reno 17 has surfaced online. The phone is shown to sport a flat rear panel with a square-shaped camera module. The handset might carry a triple rear camera unit, with two lenses placed inside a raised pill-shaped island. The third lens and an LED flash could be placed next to it. The Oppo branding appears at the bottom of the panel. Further, the report reveals that the Oppo Reno 17 will be powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset from Qualcomm, which is the same SoC as its predecessor. Also, it is said to boast a triple 50-megapixel rear camera system.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Design Spotted in Leaked Hands-On Image; Oppo Reno 17 Pro Unlikely to Launch in India

description: WhatsApp announced new calling features on Wednesday, aimed at making it easier to connect to people who do not use the messaging platform. The Meta-owned app said that its latest update removes the requirement for every participant to have a WhatsApp account. This means users can invite guests who do not use WhatsApp to audio and video calls through a shared link. It is said to maintain the same end-to-end encryption as normal WhatsApp calls.
title: WhatsApp Introduces Guest Calls for Up to 32 Participants With No Account Requirement

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 started last week. The sale brings discounts across Samsung products. Samsung deals include the Galaxy S25 Ultra at Rs. 94,999 and the Galaxy A56 5G at Rs. 31,999. Tablets and Smart TVs are also listed at reduced prices. Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Lite is listed at Rs. 30,999 against its original price of Rs. 57,999. We have gone through the listings and found the best deals on Samsung products available during the festival sale.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Deals on Samsung Smartphones, Tablets, Smart TVs, More

description: Nothing has been steadily expanding its product portfolio beyond smartphones. Most recently, the company launched two new Bluetooth speakers. A tipster now suggests that the UK-based brand could be preparing to enter another emerging wearable category. It is said to be developing two types of smart glasses, powered by artificial intelligence (AI). One version is believed to focus only on audio playback and voice assistant access, while the other one may add a camera to the mix, too.
title: Nothing Said to Be Developing Smart Glasses With ChatGPT Integration, Audio Support and Photochromic Lenses

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 is offering various LG products, like smart TVs, top-loading washing machines, front-loading washing machines, side-by-side refrigerators, single-door refrigerators, and microwave ovens, at discounted prices. For reference, you can get your hands on the LG 43-inch NU87 AI Series Nano 4K Ultra HD Smart webOS LED TV, which was launched earlier this year, at a discounted price of Rs. 31,990, instead of its listed price of Rs. 45,990. This marks a direct price cut of about Rs. 14,000. Similarly, the LG 28 L Convection Microwave Oven is listed at a relatively low price of Rs. 13,990, coming down from its listed price of Rs. 16,999.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Deals on LG Products Like Washing Machines, Smart TVs and More

description: OnePlus Ace 7 is reportedly in development for the Chinese market. A schematic shared by tipster Digital Chat Station shows the placement and airflow design of the built-in cooling fan. The upcoming handset is expected to run on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. The cooling solution could include an AI temperature sensor, patented proprietary technology and measures to minimise fan noise and dust entering the device.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Leaked Schematics Show Dual-Airflow Cooling Architecture; Launch Timeline Tipped
